title: Direct deposition of silver nanoplates on quartz surface by sequence pre-treatment hydroxylation and silanisation
author: Abu Bakar, Mat Salleh, et al.

steps.title: Gather materials and quartz
steps.instruction: Collect quartz substrate (1.2 × 1.2 cm, normal‑grade, Latech Scientific Supply) and the following reagents as received: 3‑aminopropyltrimethoxysilane 97 % (Sigma‑Aldrich), sulphuric acid 95 % (Sigma‑Aldrich), hydrogen peroxide 30 % (HmbG Chemicals), absolute ethanol (HmbG Chemicals), and the colloidal triangular silver nanoplates solution.

steps.title: Clean quartz substrate
steps.instruction: Rinse the quartz piece with absolute ethanol to remove surface contaminants and allow it to dry before any further treatment.

steps.title: Hydroxylate quartz surface
steps.instruction: Expose the cleaned quartz to a mixture of sulphuric acid 95 % and hydrogen peroxide 30 % to generate surface hydroxyl groups, then rinse thoroughly with absolute ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a hydroxylation solution by combining sulphuric acid 95 % with hydrogen peroxide 30 % (exact ratio as used in the laboratory).
Immerse the quartz substrate in this solution for the required time.
Rinse the substrate with absolute ethanol and dry.

steps.title: Silane functionalise surface
steps.instruction: Treat the hydroxylated quartz with 3‑aminopropyltrimethoxysilane 97 % to graft amine groups, followed by an ethanol rinse.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a silanisation solution of 3‑aminopropyltrimethoxysilane (97 %) in absolute ethanol.
Immerse the hydroxylated quartz in this solution for the desired incubation period.
Rinse the silanised quartz with absolute ethanol and dry.

steps.title: Immerse in silver nanoplates
steps.instruction: Place the silanised quartz into the colloidal triangular silver nanoplates solution and allow immersion for the chosen duration to achieve the desired nanoplates coverage.
